headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: May 22, 2026**
article:
The Houston Astros secured a 4-2 win over the Chicago Cubs, with Christian Vázquez leading the offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs. Spencer Arrighetti earned the win with 5 strong innings, striking out 5 and allowing 0 earned runs. The Astros also shut out the Cubs 3-0 in another game.

Injuries and availability impacted several teams, with notable players including Lourdes Gurriel Jr. (Arizona Diamondbacks), Carter Baumler (Texas Rangers), Jordan Hicks (Chicago White Sox), Mickey Moniak (Colorado Rockies), Jung Hoo Lee (San Francisco Giants), Burch Smith (Detroit Tigers), Ke'Bryan Hayes (Cincinnati Reds), and Yoán Moncada (Los Angeles Angels) all being placed on the injured list.

Several trades and roster movements took place, including the Philadelphia Phillies trading RHP Andrew Baker to the Colorado Rockies for Future Considerations, the Cincinnati Reds trading RF Rece Hinds to the Miami Marlins for RHP Zach McCambley, the Tampa Bay Rays trading LHP Joe Rock to the Chicago White Sox for 3B Oliver Dunn, and the Toronto Blue Jays trading LHP Eric Lauer to the Los Angeles Dodgers for cash.

top_news.summary: The Houston Astros secured a 4-2 win over the Chicago Cubs, with Christian Vázquez leading the offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs. Spencer Arrighetti earned the win with 5 strong innings, striking out 5 and allowing 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Guardians Shut Down Phillies in Shutout Victory**
top_news.summary: The Cleveland Guardians secured a 1-0 win over the Philadelphia Phillies, with Gavin Williams pitching 8.0 innings of scoreless baseball, striking out 11 batters and allowing just 4 hits. Kyle Manzardo led the Guardians' offense with a home run and 1 RBI.

top_news.title: **Rays Take Down Yankees 4-2**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays secured a 4-2 victory over the New York Yankees, with Austin Wells leading the offense with a home run and 1 RBI.

top_news.title: **Pirates Fall to Blue Jays in 6-2 Loss**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays took down the Pittsburgh Pirates 6-2, securing a decisive victory. Yohendrick Piñango led the Pirates' offense with 1 hit and 2 RBI in 4 at-bats.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Cruise Past Reds 8-1**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals dominated the Cincinnati Reds, securing an 8-1 victory. Iván Herrera, Alec Burleson, Jordan Walker, Bryan Torres, Victor Scott II, and Nathaniel Lowe all contributed to the Cardinals' strong performance.

top_news.title: **Astros Shut Out Cubs 3-0**
top_news.summary: The Houston Astros secured a dominant 3-0 victory over the Chicago Cubs, marking a strong performance for the Astros. Impact players on the winning side included Kai-Wei Teng, who contributed significantly on the mound.

top_news.title: **Gurriel Jr. Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Arizona Diamondbacks left fielder Lourdes Gurriel Jr. has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left hamstring strain.

top_news.title: **Phillies Make Roster Move**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies traded RHP Andrew Baker to the Colorado Rockies on May 22, 2026, in exchange for future considerations and international bonus pool money.
